featured_reviews.name: tabraze ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Product is worthless. Their response on filing a complaint will be nothing short of disappointing and only reinforces the fact that Birkenstock is hiding behind a 3-month warranty excuse instead of standing by the quality of its so-called premium products.

It is utterly shocking that sandals worth several thousand rupees are deteriorating within 4–5 months of careful use, yet Birkenstock refuses to take any responsibility. Frankly, this makes your products worse than roadside sandals, as even local vendors offer longer warranties and better accountability.

If Birkenstock truly values its customers, it should not dismiss genuine grievances so conveniently. A brand that claims to be premium must also act premium in after-sales service. Right now, both your product quality and your customer support are failing miserably.

This experience will certainly influence not only my future buying decisions but also what I share with others about Birkenstock’s standards.
